_comment: SYNTHETIC. Not metered data. The month-to-month shape is real published demand; the shape within a day is illustrative, because no public dataset carries half-hourly domestic gas volumes. Do not present it as an observed household.

basis.annualEnergy: 9,500 kWh a year, Ofgem's medium gas Typical Domestic Consumption Value
basis.conversion: kWh = m3 x 39.5 MJ/m3 x 1.02264 / 3.6, the calculation fixed by the Gas (Calculation of Thermal Energy) Regulations 1996
basis.monthlyShares: DESNZ Energy Trends table ET 4.2, domestic natural gas demand, mean of 2023 and 2024. The share of a year falling in each month barely moves between them (January 0.1656 and 0.1634), so this is a typical year rather than one year's particular winter.
basis.dailyShape: Illustrative, not measured: an overnight trough, a morning peak and a larger evening one. Gas carries a constant emissions factor, so the shape within a day cannot change a carbon calculation.
